name: No Humanity - Internship
description:
About This Game

Dig Deeper. Die Cheaper.

In No Humanity - Internship, you are one of countless disposable interns sent into a collapsing corporate drill-ship in search of something almost forgotten: humanity. Descend through hostile cave biomes, swing through hazards, fight off creatures, gather scraps, and bolt ridiculous weapons onto your machinery. Your supervisor demands progress. The cave demands bodies. Every death is expected, every replacement is ready, and every upgrade pushes the operation deeper toward whatever is still waiting below.

Arm Your Drill!

Gather resources from the cave and turn them into survival tools, weapons, rooms, and upgrades for your drill-ship. Mount guns, reinforce your machinery, expand the colony, and keep the operation moving before the cave tears everything apart.

Fight the Burples

The Burples are strange bird people defending the cave and whatever humanity left behind. Fight through swarms, dodge deadly attacks, and survive long enough to discover why they are so desperate to keep you out.

Terminate Major Blockers

Every biome has something huge standing between you and humanity. Battle Burple royalty, corrupted machines, and cave-born anomalies that test your weapons, your drill, and your interns’ ability to remain employed/alive.

Can an Unpaid Intern Find Humanity?

Interns are the heart of the colony: underpaid, overworked, and completely unprepared for what waits underground. Assign them to construction, repairs, mining, exploration, and survival while trying to keep the entire operation from falling apart. As the colony expands, interns unlock new roles, equipment, and increasingly questionable workplace responsibilities.

Before No Humanity

Before 50 million players faced the chaos of No Humanity - The Hardest Game, someone had to find humanity first.

Internship is the buried prequel: the story of disposable interns, corporate drilling, questionable cloning, and the underground expedition that made everything worse.
short_desc: No Humanity - InternShip is a chaotic physics-based space survival game where interns swing, smash, and build their way to survival. Use rope mechanics to collect resources, battle enemies, and expand your space colony. Explore humorous cave biomes and survive absurd corporate tasks in deep space.
